SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File & No: B. REGISTRY. No D 5793 Date 10 - 1 - 34）
Date April 10, 1934

Subject (in full) A. N. Loktin, Soviet Employee.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by J.B.Ku. D.I.

Afanasy Nikiforovitch Loktin, Russian, 46 years of age,
employee of Torgpredstvo (Soviet Commercial Mission), arrived
at Shanghai from Dairen on April 4, 1934, by the s.s. "Dairen
Maru", accompanied by his wife. He holds U.S.S.R. passport
No. 5115 issued on 9.9.31 at Tokio. His wife Tatiana
Ivanovna Loktin is a Russian, 42 years of age. Loktin first
stayed in the Astor House Hotel but on April 8, 1934, he removed
to unknown address.

Inquiries proceeding re: place of residence. D.S.

J. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
